description.text: The French print of Arceus, DP Black Star Promo DP50: French collectors' lists place it in a Supreme Victors Poster Pack and Poster Box, and it was given with the DVD of the twelfth Pokémon film.
The French print of Arceus LV.X, printed as "Arceus", DP Black Star Promo DP53: French collectors' lists place it in the green Boîte Collector Arceus tin.

Porte de départ, DP Black Star Promo DP54, a Trainer card printed only in French: it reprints Beginning Door from the Arceus expansion, which France never got as a set of its own. French collectors' lists place it in the Tripack PL03 Porte de Départ, a three-pack blister of the Supreme Victors expansion.

Zone ultime, DP Black Star Promo DP55, a Stadium card printed only in French: it reprints Ultimate Zone from the Arceus expansion, which France never got as a set of its own. It came in one in two copies of issue 7 of the French magazine Cour de Récré, dated April and May 2010.
